laws.rule: Montecristo National Park, Metapán: the ministry requires 4x4 vehicles for access and does not allow pets or disposable plastic. Take all waste back out. Entry is paid in cash. Submit the completed Montecristo entry application and visitor list to MARN before the visit; contact the authority to arrange entry.

Los Volcanes National Park, San Blas or Las Brumas: the ministry entry-service page says an advance application form is not strictly necessary and visitors may arrive without advance notice. This exception is not a guarantee that a summit route or a particular date is open.
